summary: Iteration 19 - Comprehensive User-Side Testing. Backend APIs all working (200 OK). Frontend login and navigation working after backend restart. Critical issue: DB pool timeout causing SSL connection drops and 503 errors, leading to slow/stuck login (5+ minutes). After backend restart, all flows work normally.

critical.issue: DB_POOL_TIMEOUT - SSL connection has been closed unexpectedly. Causes 503 errors and extremely slow responses (130+ seconds). Login took 315 seconds before restart.
critical.rca: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion or SSL connection drops from Supabase. Connections are not being properly recycled.
critical.mitigation: Backend restart clears the pool. Long-term fix: implement connection pool health checks, reduce pool size, or add connection recycling.

minor.issue: All exchange connections show 'invalid_key' status - expected for test environment but should show clear user guidance

integration_issues.issue: Login button stuck on 'İşleniyor...' when backend is slow due to DB pool timeout. No timeout handling or user feedback for slow responses.

issues: Skeleton loaders show but content may not load if backend is slow - no error state shown

action_items: CRITICAL: Investigate and fix DB pool timeout issue - SSL connections being dropped unexpectedly
Add connection pool health monitoring and auto-recovery
Add frontend timeout handling for login - show error after 30s instead of infinite spinner
Consider implementing connection pool recycling or reducing pool size
critical_code_review_comments: DB pool configuration may need tuning - current settings causing connection exhaustion under load
Frontend login has no timeout - should abort and show error after reasonable time (30s)
Backend correctly returns 503 for DB pool timeout (good error contract compliance)

success_rate.frontend: 90% (login works but slow response handling needs improvement)

context_for_next_testing_agent: DB pool timeout is intermittent infrastructure issue. If login is slow/stuck, restart backend with 'sudo supervisorctl restart backend'. All user pages (dashboard, scanner, signals, bots, portfolio) work correctly when backend is healthy. Exchange connections show invalid_key which is expected for test environment.
